index d7d9bd04..75335763 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/loaders.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/loaders.py
@@ -71,6 +71,55 @@ class BaseLoader:
     #: .. versionadded:: 2.4
     has_source_access = True
 
+    #: An optional callable that receives the requested template name
+    #: and returns the name that is actually used to look up the
+    #: template. ``None`` disables the transformation.
+    path_transform: t.Optional[t.Callable[[str], str]] = None
+
+    def transform_path(self, template: str) -> str:
+        """Apply :attr:`path_transform` to ``template``, if it is set.
+        Exceptions raised by the transform function propagate.
+        """
+        if self.path_transform is None:
+            return template
+        return self.path_transform(template)
+
+    def _not_found_name(self, original: str, resolved: str) -> str:
+        # With a path transform, errors report the name that was
+        # requested rather than the transformed one.
+        if self.path_transform is not None:
+            return original
+        return resolved
+
+    def _get_aliases(self) -> t.Dict[str, str]:
+        # Subclasses don't always call ``BaseLoader.__init__``, so the
+        # alias mapping is created lazily on first access.
+        try:
+            return self.__dict__["_aliases"]  # type: ignore
+        except KeyError:
+            aliases: t.Dict[str, str] = {}
+            self.__dict__["_aliases"] = aliases
+            return aliases
+
+    def add_alias(self, alias: str, target: str) -> None:
+        """Make the template ``target`` also available under the name
+        ``alias``. Adding an existing alias again replaces its target.
+        Aliases are not resolved recursively.
+        """
+        self._get_aliases()[alias] = target
+
+    def remove_alias(self, alias: str) -> None:
+        """Remove an alias added with :meth:`add_alias`. Removing an
+        alias that doesn't exist does nothing.
+        """
+        self._get_aliases().pop(alias, None)
+
+    def resolve_template_name(self, template: str) -> str:
+        """Return the template name that ``template`` is an alias for,
+        or ``template`` itself if it isn't an alias.
+        """
+        return self._get_aliases().get(template, template)
+
     def get_source(
         self, environment: "Environment", template: str
     ) -> t.Tuple[str, t.Optional[str], t.Optional[t.Callable[[], bool]]]:
@@ -95,7 +144,11 @@ class BaseLoader:
             raise RuntimeError(
                 f"{type(self).__name__} cannot provide access to the source"
             )
-        raise TemplateNotFound(template)
+        raise TemplateNotFound(
+            self._not_found_name(
+                template, self.resolve_template_name(self.transform_path(template))
+            )
+        )
 
     def list_templates(self) -> t.List[str]:
         """Iterates over all templates.  If the loader does not support that
@@ -180,6 +233,7 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
         searchpath: t.Union[str, os.PathLike, t.Sequence[t.Union[str, os.PathLike]]],
         encoding: str = "utf-8",
         followlinks: bool = False,
+        path_transform: t.Optional[t.Callable[[str], str]] = None,
     ) -> None:
         if not isinstance(searchpath, abc.Iterable) or isinstance(searchpath, str):
             searchpath = [searchpath]
@@ -187,11 +241,17 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
         self.searchpath = [os.fspath(p) for p in searchpath]
         self.encoding = encoding
         self.followlinks = followlinks
+        self.path_transform = path_transform
 
     def get_source(
         self, environment: "Environment", template: str
     ) -> t.Tuple[str, str, t.Callable[[], bool]]:
-        pieces = split_template_path(template)
+        name = template
+        template = self.resolve_template_name(self.transform_path(template))
+        try:
+            pieces = split_template_path(template)
+        except TemplateNotFound:
+            raise TemplateNotFound(self._not_found_name(name, template)) from None
         for searchpath in self.searchpath:
             filename = os.path.join(searchpath, *pieces)
             f = open_if_exists(filename)
@@ -211,7 +271,7 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
                     return False
 
             return contents, filename, uptodate
-        raise TemplateNotFound(template)
+        raise TemplateNotFound(self._not_found_name(name, template))
 
     def list_templates(self) -> t.List[str]:
         found = set()
@@ -269,6 +329,7 @@ class PackageLoader(BaseLoader):
         package_name: str,
         package_path: "str" = "templates",
         encoding: str = "utf-8",
+        path_transform: t.Optional[t.Callable[[str], str]] = None,
     ) -> None:
         package_path = os.path.normpath(package_path).rstrip(os.path.sep)
 
@@ -281,6 +342,7 @@ class PackageLoader(BaseLoader):
         self.package_path = package_path
